d: Short, chin-length dark purple hair with a voluminous, fluffy texture and blunt-cut bangs. Large, almond-shaped eyes in a vibrant shade of magenta with a gentle, smiling expression. A youthful face with a mature, serene appearance and a slender, feminine build. Wearing a black, form-fitting dress with a white chest panel, a high collar accented by a thin red ribbon, and white trim along the hem; black gloves cover the hands. A golden, circular ring floats horizontally above the head.
